say:1:1720903001:1.text: The palace is a nest of vipers...

say:5:1720903003:1.text: You haven't heard? It's all over the papers! The nobles who disappeared are back from the Hall of Ancients, and now some of them are saying the whole thing was staged by the queen.
say:5:1720903003:1.source_cn: 你没听说吗？报纸上都写了！那些消失的贵族都从圣古堂回来...

choice_prompt:6:1720903003.text: You haven't heard? It's all over the papers! The nobles who disappeared are back from the Hall of Ancients, and now some of them are saying the whole thing was staged by the queen.
choice_prompt:6:1720903003.source_cn: 你没听说吗？报纸上都写了！那些消失的贵族都从圣古堂回来了，亲历者亲口说圣古堂消失是王后的阴谋！

say:7:1720903004:1.text: Come on, isn't it obvious? If the princess disappeared too, the whole thing would look real! The paper says it was all meant to turn public opinion and push the blame onto the prince!
say:7:1720903004:1.source_cn: 这你就不懂了吧，报纸上都写了！让佩吉和圣古堂一起消失是...

say:9:1720903005:1.text: That gives her too much credit. People aren't fools. You can't spin a lie that big and expect everyone to buy it!
say:9:1720903005:1.source_cn: 王后把操纵舆论想得太简单了，大伙都是明辨是非的，怎么可...

say:10:1720903006:1.text: She probably thought she'd gotten away with it. Then Rolan saw through the whole scheme. Excalibur, the sword in the stone, worked its magic, and everyone trapped in the hall came back safe and sound.
say:10:1720903006:1.source_cn: 她绝对想不到，罗兰大帝识破了她的诡计，石中剑显灵，让那...

say:11:1720903007:1.text: I feel bad for Princess Peggy. She's just an innocent child...
say:11:1720903007:1.source_cn: 只是可怜了佩吉公主，那么天真可爱的小女孩……

say:12:1720903008:1.text: A child, sure. Innocent? That's another question. The paper says you can't rule out the possibility that she was in on it with the queen.
say:12:1720903008:1.source_cn: 天真可爱？你怎么知道佩吉公主一点都不知情的？报纸上都写...

say:13:1720903009:1.text: And this isn't even the first story. There were earlier reports too, about the queen's lavish lifestyle, even rumors that she'd been cursing the king with magic...
say:13:1720903009:1.source_cn: 你们看没看过之前的报道，王后平时生活奢靡，还偷偷用魔法...

say:14:1720903010:1.text: I saw that one. Was the gold bathtub story real?
say:14:1720903010:1.source_cn: 那期报纸我也看了！王后真的在金子做的浴缸里洗澡吗？

choice_prompt:15:1720903010.text: I saw that one. Was the gold bathtub story real?
choice_prompt:15:1720903010.source_cn: 那期报纸我也看了！王后真的在金子做的浴缸里洗澡吗？

say:16:1720903011:1.text: The Savannah Eye. Who else? They always get the juicy stuff before anyone else does!
say:16:1720903011:1.source_cn: 当然是《赛凡纳之眼》了！这可是咱们赛凡纳消息最灵通的报纸！

say:17:1720903013:1.text: Anyway, it's a lot more interesting than the palace's usual polished nonsense!
say:17:1720903013:1.source_cn: 这报纸上写的，可比官方那些陈词滥调劲爆多了！

choice:15:0:1.text: Hold on. What paper are we talking about?
choice:15:0:1.source_cn: 所以，究竟是什么报纸上写的？
choice:15:0:1.male: Hold on. What paper are we talking about?
choice:15:0:1.female: Hold on. What paper are we talking about?

say:19:1720903012:1.text: Go read the latest issue yourself. It's one of those stories that gets messier the more you explain it!
say:19:1720903012:1.source_cn: 你去买一份最新的《赛凡纳之眼》就知道了！事情太复杂，几...

choice:15:1:2.text: Alright. So what did it actually say?
choice:15:1:2.source_cn: 所以，报纸上究竟写了什么？
choice:15:1:2.male: Alright. So what did it actually say?
choice:15:1:2.female: Alright. So what did it actually say?

choice:6:0:1.text: But Peggy disappeared with them, didn't she?
choice:6:0:1.source_cn: 可佩吉公主也在里面啊？
choice:6:0:1.male: But Peggy disappeared with them, didn't she?
choice:6:0:1.female: But Peggy disappeared with them, didn't she?

choice:6:1:2.text: Why would the queen pull something like that?
choice:6:1:2.source_cn: 王后这么做有什么好处啊？
choice:6:1:2.male: Why would the queen pull something like that?
choice:6:1:2.female: Why would the queen pull something like that?

choice:4:1:2.text: What do you mean by that?
choice:4:1:2.male: What do you mean by that?
choice:4:1:2.female: What do you mean by that?
